user_summary: 开发版启动后云端授权与 Provider 启用状态不再错误恢复为默认关闭；配置以后端持久化为唯一事实源。
technical_summary: Browser-dev uses repo ./data SQLite while packaged uses LOCALAPPDATA; shared Windows keyring made credentials look configured while cloud_enabled/provider switches read false from the isolated DB. AliyunForm also defaulted enabled=false before hydrate and could overwrite. Added config-profile API/banner, hydrate gates, and accurate RATE_LIMITED (429) messaging that preserves enablement flags.
acceptance_criteria: Backend cloud_enabled=true stays true after page init
Backend provider_enabled=true stays true after page init
UI defaults never overwrite saved backend flags before hydrate
Save then refresh keeps cloud and provider enabled
API Key never enters localStorage; full key never returned
Browser-dev banner shows isolated config environment
HTTP 429 shows rate_limited without incomplete-config copy
verification_evidence: Local: 22 pytest passed; 20 vitest passed; typecheck passed; version check 1.0.3; change_registry check passed; git diff --check passed. Confirmed prod DB cloud_enabled=true vs worktree data/storylens.db cloud_enabled=false with shared keyring.

data_compatibility.notes: No schema migration. Dev and packaged SQLite remain isolated by design; keyring remains machine-scoped.
